question_text: A motor lifts a 40 kg load vertically through 6 m in 12 s at constant speed. Its efficiency from electrical input to useful lifting work is 75%. Take g = 10 m/s² and ignore all other useful outputs. What average electrical input power is required?

question_text: A 500 W heater operates for 200 s and transfers 80% of its electrical energy to 0.50 kg of ice initially at −10°C. Use ice specific heat 2000 J/(kg·°C) and latent heat of fusion 3.5 × 10^5 J/kg. Ignore container heat capacity. At the end, how much ice has melted?

question_text: An ammeter reads the total current entering two parallel branches: an unknown resistor R and a voltmeter of resistance 600 Ω. The voltmeter reads 6.0 V and the ammeter reads 40 mA.
